data.name: Afaqiyah
data.gender_notes: Afaqiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Afaqiyah is a name that symbolizes the vastness and beauty of the universe, representing a person with a broad and open-minded perspective. The name Afaqiyah carries the meaning “Horizon of the universe” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Afaqiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody horizon of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the horizon is a symbol of the infinite and the unknown, reflecting the believer's quest for knowledge and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Afaqiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Horizon of the universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afaqiyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_urdu.meaning: نام جس کا مطلب ہے انتہائی حد یا اختتامی حد
